header: Sensex and Nifty, with the day's line and change, and the biggest movers of a fixed watch list of large companies (SAIL among them). Market data comes from a public feed, possibly delayed about fifteen minutes, and is NEVER advice: the card says both, and I name the list instead of claiming to show the whole market. Nothing typed is sent anywhere.

doc: Each index has its own deep gradient with white text, so that it stands out from the card's own pale green. The change pill and the line say whether the day is up or down: green on a dark tile would be lost, so I make the line white and keep the pill the pale green or red it always was.
